BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

2. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   D. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.

4. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.

8. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   C. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   C. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
